Recent reports of a rise in human metapneumovirus (hMPV) cases in China have raised public health concerns.

While hMPV often presents with mild cold- and flu-like symptoms, it can progress to more severe respiratory conditions such as bronchitis, bronchiolitis, and pneumonia. https://t.co/5g3XeGUXjq
